reviews.summary: A live Orca governance proposal could materially alter ORCA’s governance and treasury structure during the current signal window, creating event-driven uncertainty despite normal ORCA/EUR exchange status.
materialRisks: A September 29, 2026 tokenholder proposal would transfer approximately 14.2M ORCA from the community treasury to a Team-controlled Strategic Account, subject to future acquisition deployment. ([forums.orca.so](https://forums.orca.so/t/tokenholder-proposal-resourcing-orca-for-its-next-phase/1281?utm_source=openai))

The same proposal would redirect 80% of protocol fees to the Team and dissolve the Council/limit tokenholder voting scope if passed; its stated process includes a 5-day tokenholder vote and 2-day cooldown, making timing-sensitive governance risk current. ([forums.orca.so](https://forums.orca.so/t/tokenholder-proposal-resourcing-orca-for-its-next-phase/1281?utm_source=openai))

facts.fact: The market identity is Orca Protocol’s Solana-based ORCA token: Kraken lists an active ORCA/EUR market and reports ORCA-Solana operational. ([kraken.com](https://www.kraken.com/convert/orca/eur?utm_source=openai))

The official Orca governance forum posted the restructuring proposal on September 29, 2026; it states that the Council had unanimously endorsed submitting it to tokenholders. ([forums.orca.so](https://forums.orca.so/t/tokenholder-proposal-resourcing-orca-for-its-next-phase/1281?utm_source=openai))
No current ORCA-specific Kraken operational impairment was shown on the exchange status page at the time checked. ([status.kraken.com](https://status.kraken.com/?utm_source=openai))

A Phemex ORCA/USDT spot-pair delisting occurred on August 27, 2026, but this is not evidence of impairment in the specific ORCA/EUR market. ([phemex.com](https://phemex.com/announcements/phemex-will-delist-the-perp-usdt-spot-pair-100471?utm_source=openai))
